notes.title: Demo update 1.0a is now live!
notes.notes:
As a solo dev, things can get pretty tough when it comes to testing and fault finding, as well as keeping this looking and feeling good. 
I have noted all the feedback since the demo release and here is the next update for the demo and as such, will cement the foundation of the full game a little better. 
Here are some of the issues I have addressed, but could still potentially need some more work:

- Loading and saving bugs and issues.
- Updated the sound and music in some areas.
- Added quick teleport via shrines.
- Added healing wells to the levels. 
- Reworked some of the character, enemy and boss animations when using spells etc.
- Added the ability to click on items to collect them.
- Small UI updates.
- Addressed certain optimization issues.
- Updated the menu settings.
- Added the ability to quick save and load with F5 and F6.

These are only some of the updates and improvements. I'm sure I forgot a few already. All in all, I'm hoping it will be a slightly more solid experience. From my side, i will still continue to bring out more updates and content. So do consider following and supporting this journey on Twitter: @DarkFactionZA

Regards,
DFG

notes.title: Demo update released for NextFest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41950771/03c6ac2884d7d4af99512bc4301b196cf0645d4b.png[/img]

So i didnt actually get this done in time but better late than never right. I had some factors outside of my control that influenced my dev time. Here are some fixes:
- Added tutorial dialogs by talking to the relevant NPC's instead of having random popups in the 
  beginning of the game. I just hope players actually read them!
- Updated the graphics, sound and keybinding options but making the settings persistant and added a 
   Vsync option as requested by a player.
-Fixed a load game bug where the game loaded into a black screen and loaded a second character.
- Updated the UI code slightly and added a button to reset the inventory canvas positions.
- Fixed some issues with LOD.
- Updated the code that saves and loads the game.

Again, this demo is technically not in beta yet, but I hope everyone is finding some value in this. If you have a few requests that would improve the game in your opinion, feel free to contact or email to info@darkfactiongames.com. Your feedback counts!

notes.title: Development update!
notes.notes:
Thanks for dropping in to read this update!

Good news on the development progress so far. Everything is coming along nicely and something noteworthy would be that players can now play Co-op via LAN.

Its a small addition to the game, but I think would make a different to some people. From there, I will officially start working on the campaign and then at a later stage, once I have a few chapters done, revisit the multiplayer and add support for teaming up over the internet.
There has also been major improvements to the player and enemy movement and animations as well as enemy AI.

The network development is taking up massive chunks of development time for me, but hopefully I can provide more exciting updates soon!

Regards,
DFG
